#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

struct Dinic {
    struct Edge {
        int t, rev;
        ll cap, f;
        Edge(int t, int rev, ll cap) : t(t), rev(rev), cap(cap), f(0) {}
    };
    vector<vector<Edge>> g;
    Dinic(int n) : g(n) {}
    void add(int s, int t, ll cap) {
        g[s].emplace_back(t, (int)g[t].size(), cap);
        g[t].emplace_back(s, (int)g[s].size() - 1, 0);
    }
    bool bfs(int s, int t, vector<int>& d) {
        fill(d.begin(), d.end(), -1);
        d[s] = 0;
        vector<int> q(g.size());
        int qs = 0;
        q[qs++] = s;
        for (int i = 0; i < qs; i++) {
            int u = q[i];
            for (Edge& e : g[u]) {
                if (d[e.t] < 0 && e.f < e.cap) {
                    d[e.t] = d[u] + 1;
                    q[qs++] = e.t;
                }
            }
        }
        return d[t] >= 0;
    }
    ll dfs(vector<int>& ptr, vector<int>& d, int t, int u, ll f) {
        if (u == t) return f;
        for (; ptr[u] < (int)g[u].size(); ++ptr[u]) {
            Edge& e = g[u][ptr[u]];
            if (d[e.t] == d[u] + 1 && e.f < e.cap) {
                ll df = dfs(ptr, d, t, e.t, min(f, e.cap - e.f));
                if (df > 0) {
                    e.f += df;
                    g[e.t][e.rev].f -= df;
                    return df;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }
    ll maxFlow(int s, int t) {
        ll flow = 0;
        vector<int> d(g.size());
        while (bfs(s, t, d)) {
            vector<int> ptr(g.size(), 0);
            while (true) {
                ll df = dfs(ptr, d, t, s, LLONG_MAX);
                if (df == 0) break;
                flow += df;
            }
        }
        return flow;
    }
};

struct MinCost {
    struct Edge {
        int to, f, cap, cost, rev;
        Edge(int to, int cap, int cost, int rev) : to(to), cap(cap), cost(cost), rev(rev), f(0) {}
    };
    vector<vector<Edge>> g;
    MinCost(int n) : g(n) {}
    void add(int s, int t, int cap, int cost) {
        g[s].emplace_back(t, cap, cost, (int)g[t].size());
        g[t].emplace_back(s, 0, -cost, (int)g[s].size() - 1);
    }
    void spfa(int s, vector<int>& dist, vector<int>& prevNode, vector<int>& prevEdge, vector<int>& curFlow) {
        int n = (int)g.size();
        fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), INT_MAX);
        dist[s] = 0;
        curFlow[s] = INT_MAX;
        vector<bool> inQ(n, false);
        queue<int> q;
        q.push(s);
        inQ[s] = true;
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front(); q.pop();
            inQ[u] = false;
            for (int i = 0; i < (int)g[u].size(); i++) {
                Edge& e = g[u][i];
                if (e.f >= e.cap) continue;
                int v = e.to;
                int nd = dist[u] + e.cost;
                if (dist[v] > nd) {
                    dist[v] = nd;
                    prevNode[v] = u;
                    prevEdge[v] = i;
                    curFlow[v] = min(curFlow[u], e.cap - e.f);
                    if (!inQ[v]) {
                        inQ[v] = true;
                        q.push(v);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    vector<int> minCostFlow(int s, int t, int maxf) {
        int n = (int)g.size();
        vector<int> dist(n), curFlow(n), prevEdge(n), prevNode(n);
        int flow = 0, cost = 0;
        while (flow < maxf) {
            spfa(s, dist, prevNode, prevEdge, curFlow);
            if (dist[t] == INT_MAX) break;
            int df = min(curFlow[t], maxf - flow);
            flow += df;
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevNode[v]) {
                Edge& e = g[prevNode[v]][prevEdge[v]];
                e.f += df;
                g[v][e.rev].f -= df;
                cost += df * e.cost;
            }
        }
        return {flow, cost};
    }
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int N, M, K, C, D;
    cin >> N >> M >> K >> C >> D;
    vector<int> pos(N, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        pos[x - 1]++;
    }
    const int T = 100;
    MinCost mf((T + 1) * N + 2);
    int source = 0;
    int sink = (T + 1) * N + 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        if (pos[i] > 0) {
            mf.add(source, i + 1, pos[i], 0);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < T; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
            mf.add(1 + i * N + j, 1 + (i + 1) * N + j, K, 0);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i <= T; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= K; j++) {
            mf.add(1 + i * N, sink, 1, C * i);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
        int a, b;
        cin >> a >> b;
        a--; b--;
        for (int j = 0; j < T; j++) {
            int cost = 0;
            for (int l = 1; l <= K; l++) {
                mf.add(1 + j * N + a, 1 + (j + 1) * N + b, 1, l * l * D - cost);
                mf.add(1 + j * N + b, 1 + (j + 1) * N + a, 1, l * l * D - cost);
                cost = l * l * D;
            }
        }
    }
    vector<int> res = mf.minCostFlow(source, sink, K);
    cerr << res[0] << endl;
    cout << res[1] << endl;
    return 0;
}
